svg.text: Part imagery & 3D — accurate, legal, offline (your call)
Goal: replace vague 3D blobs with the EXACT correlative image for each part, and show it in the collection preview boxes.
Hard caveats — why 'download real CAD for every part' isn't the path
ITAR: CAD/repair/maintenance data for military NSN parts is CONTROLLED technical data — not freely downloadable, not bundleable, and this is an OFFLINE system anyway.
Web CAD (GrabCAD/TraceParts/McMaster): license-restricted, can't be redistributed, and rarely matches the exact NSN/variant.
AI-generated 3D (text/image -> mesh): produces an APPROXIMATION, not engineering-accurate geometry. Presenting it as authoritative in a maintenance tool is a safety/accuracy risk.
So 'find/scan/generate accurate CAD for all parts' can't be done safely or legally. But the GOAL — an accurate, correlative image per part — is very achievable:
The accurate, legal, offline answer
🖼 Use the manual's OWN figure
Every part already cites its figure + page (parts table).
Crop that exploded-view illustration -> the EXACT, cited
image of that part.
US Army TMs are public-domain; nothing to license.
Authoritative & correlative.
📦 Preview boxes = real results
The 3D collection cards show that crop (the actual part),
not a generic blob. Modal gets a 'Manual illustration'
tab.
Lazy-extract + cache as a sidecar (index never written).
Exactly what you asked for.
🧰 Keep parametric 3D (honest)
For primitive families (bolt/nut/gasket/bearing) it's
dimensionally accurate from FLIS — keep as the
interactive
view, clearly labeled 'representative', paired with the
crop.
Interactive where it's truthful.
GPU's real role here (honest)
GPU genuinely helps: batch figure-region + caption detection across the corpus, and an OPTIONAL offline image-similarity pass to pick the best crop per part. But the PDF page render itself is mostly
CPU/IO — so this is an accuracy win, not primarily a GPU-horsepower win. I'll be straight about that.
Recommended (pick any mix — your final call)
A) Figure-crop extraction = authoritative image in preview boxes + a 'Manual illustration' tab (DEFAULT, recommended). B) Keep/strengthen FLIS-driven parametric 3D as the interactive 'representative'
view. C) OPT-IN only, clearly labeled offline approximation for parts with no figure — I recommend NOT making this default in a maintenance tool. All sidecar/cached, RPS-safe, index never written.
Decision diagram. Dark (R3). Sources: pmddtc.state.gov / federalregister.gov (ITAR technical-data). For THE VIEWER 3D/preview overhaul.
